WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy notice

How this website handles your information. Effective 11 October 2026.

Website operator

Guangzhou PanPanTech Co., Ltd. operates PanPan Marine. For enquiries about this website or information you send us, contact panda@panpantechnology.com.

Project-brief form

When you press Send, the details you enter are transmitted to the enquiry system operated by Guangzhou PanPanTech Co., Ltd. and recorded in our internal sales tools so that our team can review your request and reply. The site does not store your form contents in browser storage.

If online sending is unavailable, the form offers a download or an email draft instead. An email draft is only sent if you press Send in your mail application; your email provider’s privacy terms apply to that transmission.

Hosting and external services

The hosting service may process connection information needed to deliver and secure the website. No marketing analytics, advertising pixels or optional tracking cookies have been added by this site. External links lead to services with their own privacy practices.

Downloads

Downloaded briefs remain on your device. Delete them when no longer needed and avoid including confidential information in an initial inquiry.

Business contact and review

Business enquiries you choose to email to us are used to review your request and correspond with you. Contact us using the email above with questions about information you have provided. The quotation identifies the legal seller and agreed commercial responsibilities. This notice describes the current enquiry workflow.
